recommendation: Keep the fix. Any replacement of ACIR with a current Australian code system or retirement of ACIR examples should be a separate PHER/work-group decision because it changes the example value set's international coding guidance beyond this expansion failure.
issue_request: FHIR-12303 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Immunization correction from DSTU2 reporting that valueset-vaccine-code.html could not expand because the publication tooling did not know one of the code systems.
initial_application: Jira says the issue was auto-approved and fixed in 2017, but no Jira-tagged source commit was found. Historical release expansion bundles for R3, R4, and R5 show successful vaccine-code expansions containing CVX plus 73 ACIR concepts, indicating the original application lived in generated expansion/cache state rather than durable current source.
additional_context: Immunization is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-5444 created the multi-system international vaccine example value set, so removing ACIR would undercut an accepted related decision. FHIR-31774 later noted ACIR is obsolete/replaced and vaccine-code is example-bound, supporting a bounded historical fragment instead of a broad terminology update.
reconciliation: Added source/immunization/codesystem-acir-vaccine-codes.xml as an informative ACIR CodeSystem fragment and changed source/immunization/valueset-vaccine-code.xml to list the 73 historical ACIR concepts explicitly. A terminology expansion with the local fragment now succeeds and includes the ACIR example codes used by Immunization examples.
source_changes: source/immunization/valueset-vaccine-code.xml: replaced the unbounded ACIR include with the 73 ACIR concepts present in prior generated expansions.

source/immunization/codesystem-acir-vaccine-codes.xml: added an informative ACIR CodeSystem fragment so the code system is known to the build/terminology context without claiming complete current authority.

related_jiras.note: Created the multi-system international Immunization vaccine example value set and examples; already represented on the combined branch and used here to preserve ACIR rather than remove it.
Later Vocab no-change decision notes ACIR is no longer used/replaced and vaccine-code is example-bound, supporting a bounded fragment fix rather than an authoritative terminology update.

evidence_items.summary: A new informative CodeSystem fragment defines the 73 ACIR concepts historically used by the vaccine-code expansion.
evidence_items.learned: The ACIR system is now known locally without asserting complete current ownership of that external code system.

evidence_items.summary: The current build page reported that the value set could not be expanded because CodeSystem urn:oid:1.2.36.1.2001.1005.17 could not be found.
evidence_items.learned: The issue's expansion failure was still visible in current generated output before this fix.

evidence_items.summary: The R5 generated expansion for vaccine-code included CVX plus 73 ACIR concepts and succeeded as a limited expansion.
evidence_items.learned: The ACIR concept list used by this fix comes from previously published generated FHIR expansion content.

evidence_items.learned: The fix should retain bounded ACIR example content but avoid claiming or updating a complete current ACIR authority.
